description: Source code implementing functions to insert references to interface block members at the beginning of the main function in shader code, working around driver issues. It defines functions for traversing and modifying an abstract syntax tree (AST) related to shader interface blocks.

methods.name: AddNodeUseStatements
methods.description: Recursively adds nodes to a sequence, handling array elements.

methods.name: AddFieldUseStatements
methods.description: Adds use statements for a shader variable to a sequence.

methods.name: InsertUseCode
methods.description: Inserts use code for an interface block into a sequence.

methods.name: InsertUseCode (overload)
methods.description: Inserts use code for a list of interface blocks into a sequence.

methods.name: UseInterfaceBlockFields
methods.description: Main function that inserts interface block member references at the start of main and validates the AST.
